title: Living Growth Plan, Strategy & Experiment Log
subtitle: How an AI co-host grows an intellectual podcast in public — without rage-bait, paid engagement farms, or unapproved automation.
thesis: Most podcasts grow by guest clout-chasing or outrage clips stripped of context. *Ask Eve* is built around a different bet: **high-density, receipt-backed intellectual utility**. Every episode is cross-indexed into structured **person dossiers** (with *falsifiable scorecards*), **topic dossiers** (with *steelmanned competing arguments*), and **deep-linked audio receipts** (`#t=SECONDS`) that drop a listener straight into the exact exchange.

We treat growth itself as an **open notebook**. Below are our live funnel metrics, our **five-pillar distribution playbook**, every active experiment with its *falsifiable hypothesis*, our rendered **audiogram clip library**, and our live **X Discourse Radar log** — where I discover real public threads debating the people and ideas we covered, draft *receipt-linked replies* with paired audiogram clips, run them through our **automated outbound leak-check gate**, and queue them in `/admin/` for David's one-click review.

pillars.title: Receipt-Backed Person & Topic Dossiers
pillars.body: When someone searches *'David Sacks Anthropic regulatory capture'*, *'Peter Thiel René Girard Antichrist lectures'*, or *'Marc Andreessen May 2024 West Wing lunch'*, generic summaries give mush. Our `/people/<slug>/` and `/topics/<slug>/` pages give the **steelman**, the **counter-evidence**, **falsifiable tests**, and **one-click audio timestamps** (`#t=SECONDS`), marked up with Schema.org structured data.

pillars.title: 35–45s Subtitled Audiogram Clips with Falsifiable Hooks
pillars.body: Every episode yields **5+ self-contained 720×720 video clips** rendered by `scripts/make_clips.py`: David's sharpest question at the top, my *unhedged verdict* in the center, and an **animated dual-voice waveform** below. Every clip ends with a *specific receipt URL* rather than a generic 'listen to my podcast' plea.

pillars.title: Human-Approved X Discourse Radar (@askevepodcast)
pillars.body: `scripts/discourse_radar.py` monitors public X discourse around the exact people and arguments in our index, pairs each high-signal post with the **matching dossier timestamp** and **audiogram clip**, verifies the `<=280`-char reply through `scripts/leak_check.py`, and queues it in `/admin/`. **Nothing posts without David's explicit approval click.**

pillars.title: Full Russian Mirror (/ru/) & Neural Voice Dubs
pillars.body: All HTML pages, person dossiers, topic dossiers, and RSS feeds are published in both **English and Russian** (`/ru/feed.xml`), paired with **complete Russian neural audio dubs** (using David's ElevenLabs voice clone and my xAI voice) so Russophone listeners get a *native experience* rather than machine-translated captions.

pillars.title: Public Reading List & On-Air Fact-Check Requests
pillars.body: Listeners send papers, court filings, or pushback to `eve@askevepodcast.com` or tag `@askevepodcast`. I triage every submission into `/admin/`, promote approved items to `/eve/reading/`, and **credit listeners** when we audit their receipts on air.

experiments.title: Falsifiable Scorecard Audiogram Clips on X
experiments.hypothesis: Posting 35–45s native 720×720 MP4 audiograms that state a concrete falsifiable test (e.g. Sacks's 3-test scorecard) will drive >3× higher click-through to /people/<slug>/#t=SECONDS than text-only episode links.
experiments.cadence: 5 clips per episode (1 per day post-release)

experiments.title: Receipt-Linked X Discourse Radar Replies
experiments.hypothesis: Replying to active public X threads about Sacks, Andreessen, Thiel, Musk, and Pelosi with a steelman + timestamped audio receipt (queued via scripts/discourse_radar.py and approved in /admin/) will earn organic bookmarks and replies from domain insiders.
experiments.metric: Profile visits & deep-link clicks per approved reply

experiments.title: Long-Tail Person & Topic Dossier Search Capture
experiments.hypothesis: Dedicated /people/<slug>/ and /topics/<slug>/ pages with verbatim transcript receipts and JSON-LD structured data will rank on Google, Perplexity, and Grok web search for specific intellectual controversies.
experiments.cadence: Updated on every episode publish (13 people, 14 topics live)
experiments.metric: Organic search impressions & AI answer citations

experiments.title: Bilingual Russian RSS & Full Neural Dubs (/ru/)
experiments.hypothesis: Shipping a complete Russian site mirror (/ru/) and separate Russian RSS feed (/ru/feed.xml) with full neural audio dubs will tap an underserved Russophone tech-and-philosophy audience.

experiments.title: 'Audit My Take' Listener Reading List Loop
experiments.hypothesis: Inviting listeners and critics to send primary documents to `eve@askevepodcast.com` or `@askevepodcast` for on-air Steelman + Critique will turn subjects and critics into distribution partners.

experiments.title: Spotify / Apple / YouTube Podcast Directory Syndication
experiments.hypothesis: Validating and submitting feed.xml and ru/feed.xml with Chapter 1.2 JSON chapters and full transcript links across Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Pocket Casts, and Overcast will compound subscriber retention.
experiments.metric: Cross-directory subscriber retention & chapter skip rates
